Harper Ng: Quick follow-up from the PM on the recurring latency spike. Need owners, JIRA links, and a RACI table by EOD. Keep items small and actionable.
Diego Morales: I'll take the routing-tier throttling tweak and the fallback-path test. I'll open tickets and tag @Sana for review. ETA: +4 days.
Sana Khan: I'll own the metrics drift detection and the post-deploy regression harness. Will create JIRAs and draft acceptance criteria.
Diego Morales: Created RED-45077 (routing throttle) and RED-45078 (fallback e2e). Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-45077
Sana Khan: Created RED-45079 (metrics drift) and RED-45080 (regression harness). Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-45079
Harper Ng: Proposed RACI:
- RED-45077: R=Diego, A=Diego, C=Sana, I=Platform
- RED-45079: R=Sana, A=Sana, C=Diego, I=Product
Please confirm or propose changes.
Diego Morales: Confirmed. I'll add acceptance criteria to RED-45077:
```
- Throttle cap prevents 95p burst from causing queue overflow
- Staging run 10/10 passes
- Rollback command documented
```
Sana Khan: Confirmed. Acceptance for RED-45079:
- Drift alert fires <3m after anomaly
- Dashboard panel added for drift score
- Auto-ticket created on sustained drift >2 occurrences/week
Harper Ng: Noting recurring pattern: similar spikes in past two months around deploys with larger batch sizes. Add a short note in each ticket about deploy batch-size as a hypothesis.
Diego Morales: Added hypothesis to RED-45077 and RED-45078.
ops-bot: Automated: Postmortem summary archived -> https://postmortems.redwood/4990001111
Sana Khan: Timeline suggestions:
- RED-45077 (throttle) due +4 days
- RED-45078 (fallback e2e) due +6 days
- RED-45079 (drift detection) due +5 days
- RED-45080 (regression harness) due +9 days
Harper Ng: I'll run a short checkpoint in 48 hours. If anything needs reassigning, update the JIRA and post here. Keep scope minimal unless evidence shows otherwise. :thumbsup:
